title: Salinas and Aguada Blanca Full-Day Tour
short_description: Explore Salinas and Aguada Blanca National Reserve from Arequipa, surrounded by volcanoes, lagoons, salt flats, vicuñas, alpacas and flamingos.
long_description: Discover Salinas and Aguada Blanca National Reserve, one of Arequipa's most spectacular natural settings. Travel through high-Andean landscapes beneath Misti, Chachani and Pichu Pichu, observe native wildlife and visit the Salinas Lagoons. Ideal for nature, wildlife and photography lovers.
price_note: Price per person. Ask about rates and availability.

days.text: Depart Arequipa around 6:00 a.m. for Salinas and Aguada Blanca National Reserve. Enjoy landscapes beneath Misti, Chachani and Pichu Pichu, observe Andean wildlife and visit the Salinas Lagoons. Flamingos may be seen depending on the season. Meet local communities, take photographs and return to Arequipa around 5:00 p.m.
